decision: Preserve the semantic Canvas reducer and replace whole-document authority with a canonical per-Canvas ledger
why: The reducer already gives atomic command batches, stable IDs, and conflict checks; persistence and trust boundaries are the parts that no longer fit

decision: Use one SQLite Durable Object per Canvas and D1 only for installation-wide indexes
why: Each Canvas needs one exact commit order; installation queries span Canvases but must not become a second content authority

decision: Replace Frame URL identity with RepresentationRef and RenderPlan
why: A raw URL cannot represent one page across localhost, shared previews, and immutable artifacts

decision: Make remote agent access an OAuth Code Mode MCP with search and execute
why: Agents need a compact typed interface and delegated company identity without a separate credential system
result: accepted user input; stable transcript reference unavailable

decision: Record Agent as author and retain delegated human plus runtime provenance

decision: Move bridge safety from instructions into generated configuration and production verification

decision: Use the incremental candidate as the execution base and the clean candidate as the destination map
